events.description: The user asked to collapse a node. `preventDefault()` keeps it expanded.
events.name: ok:organization-chart:collapse

events.description: The user asked to expand a node (its toggle, or its label with `data-ok-expand-collapse-on-node-click`). `preventDefault()` keeps it collapsed.
events.name: ok:organization-chart:expand

events.description: A node whose children list is empty is expanding for the first time. Call `respondWith(nodesOrPromise)` with its child nodes (`li[data-ok-organization-chart-node]` elements, for example cloned from a `template`). No nodes make it a leaf; a rejected promise keeps it collapsed, and the next expand asks again.
events.detail: { nodeId: string | null; node: HTMLElement; respondWith(nodes: PromiseLike<OrganizationChartLoadedNodes> | OrganizationChartLoadedNodes): void; }
events.name: ok:organization-chart:loadchildren

methods.description: Collapses every node, the root included.
methods.name: collapseAll

methods.description: Collapses a node and every node under it.
methods.name: collapseSubtree

methods.description: Expands the node with this `data-ok-node-id`, loading its children first when needed. Resolves once done.

methods.description: Expands every node whose children are loaded.

methods.description: Expands a node and every loaded node under it.
methods.name: expandSubtree

methods.description: Expands the nodes above `depth` (the root is depth 0) and collapses the others.

methods.description: Whether the node with this `data-ok-node-id` shows its children.
